rows.explainer: Costs roughly based on 4 staff members plus additional buffer. These costs will increase each year during scale up ie. Staff costs will be $225,000 in year 2, $550,000 in year 3, and so on until scale is reached in year 9.

rows.label: Probability of success following pilot
rows.explainer: This is the probability of success that we will get government buy in following our pilot in private schools. We need this government buy in to reach scale as we plan to scale by working in government schools. Note given the pilot is only a very small part of the total costs this does not affect the end result much.

GiveWell moral weight: Doubled years of income equivalent in DALYs
rows.explainer: **Changed for consistency.** Ambitious Impact turns a year of doubled consumption into 0.4348 DALYs (1/2.3, its own exchange rate), kept in the evaluator view. Our view uses the site's shared values: a doubling is ln 2 of log-consumption, valued at the shared value of income (Your values), and converted to healthy years at the shared rate, so this model moves with both sliders like every income model.

summary: Ambitious Impact's 2024 estimate for a new charity giving teachers structured lesson plans and training, so primary pupils learn more. The idea Learning Alliance was founded to run. Its bottom line is the cost per DALY-equivalent in an average sub-Saharan African country; the benefit is entirely higher future income, which AIM counts at 0.43 DALYs per year of doubled consumption (1/2.3, GiveWell's rate; 'CEA (SSA)'!B68).

theoretical.reason: Ambitious Impact's estimate of the idea, written before the charity existed; not based on the charity's own results.
theoretical.runs: Learning Alliance runs structured pedagogy (lesson plans, teacher training, coaching) in 72 schools in Iganga District, Uganda.
